reviews_captured_by_me.text: Karolina and her team did an excellent job! Please take note I’m an architect and on my own I’ve designed and built my kitchen, my son’s and 5 others. This time I couldn’t, so we hired Karolina. She efficiently helped us with the design, worked carefully to obtain my daughter’s approval, and coordinated her team to carefully remove the 10 year old granite top, dispose the 30 year old cabinets, install new one, then successfully reinstall the counter tops. Their work was perfect, and we are very happy to refer them to you!
reviews_captured_by_me.owner_reply:
Response from the owner 3 years ago
Mr. Wells, it was a pleasure working with you and putting this project together for your daughter and her family. I could not asked for a better review than this. We are so very thankful and looking forward to be working with you or your referals any time. 
MK Stones and Cabinets Team

reviews_captured_by_me.text: 10* quality, with people who take great pride in their business and quality of craftsmanship. I am an exhausting client with many questions and high expectations; Karolina was always available with immediate response times and helpful insight to make the countertops in our house exactly to our liking. Even the people who came to install the stone were absolutely delightful and respectful to our home - end to end great service. Highly recommend!
reviews_captured_by_me.owner_reply:
Response from the owner 4 years ago
Thank you Ashley in taking the time in your busy schedule to review our work. It was a pleasure serving you and helping in the process of picking the right stones that suit your needs and style. MK Stones team is proud and happy to make your home countertops just the way you like it. Enjoy your countertops and like them now and tomorrow...

reviews_captured_by_me.text:
My husband and I had the privilege of working with Karolina when we were redoing our kitchen and bathrooms. From the moment we met Karolina she demonstrated courtesy, and professionalism. As the project progressed Karolina remained steadfast with prompt responses and determination to exceed our expectations. She did not falter. Not once. Her unmatched level of skill and talent coupled with her kindness and thoughtfulness make Karolina a rare find. Her installation crew was also professional, worked with precision and even did a phenomenal job cleaning up after the job was done!
We highly recommend Karolina and her crew at MK Stones And Cabinets for kitchen and bathroom remodeling.
